title: Graded-module sheaf on Proj: Stalks
statement: Let $S$ be an $\mathbb N$-graded commutative ring with grading $\mathcal A$, and $M$ a $\mathbb Z$-graded $S$-module with internal grading $\mathcal M$ compatible with scalar multiplication. Set $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Index charts by pairs $f=(a,d)$ with $d>0$ and $a\in S_d$, put $D_f=D_+(a)$, $R_f=S_{(a)}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], and let $Z_f$ be submodules of $M_a$ whose carriers are precisely the equal-degree fractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions]. Suppose additive maps $\rho_{f,g}:Z_f\to Z_g$ and ring maps $\rho^S_{f,g}:R_f\to R_g$ are given for every $D_g\subseteq D_f$. Suppose each inclusion admits a homogeneous relation $g^e=bf$ with $e>0$, each $\rho$ is semilinear over $\rho^S$, and for every such relation it sends $y/f^m$ to $b^my/g^{em}$. Assume identities, composition and bijectivity when chart opens coincide. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with additive chart identifications $\alpha_f:F(D_f)\cong Z_f$ respecting scalars via awayToSection and restrictions via $\rho$. For each point $x$ corresponding to a homogeneous prime $\mathfrak p$, the equal-degree fractions in $(S\setminus\mathfrak p)^{-1}M$ form a submodule $Z_{\mathfrak p}$ over $S_{(\mathfrak p)}$. There are additive equivalences $F_x\cong Z_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] semilinear over stalkIso, sending the germ of $\alpha_f^{-1}(y/f^m)$ to $y/f^m$ for every chart containing $x$ and every fraction representation.

proof.text: Construct the prime degree-zero submodule explicitly by equal-degree fraction addition and scalar multiplication. Apply the canonical stalk map lemma. Prove surjectivity by multiplying numerator and denominator by a positive-degree homogeneous element outside the point prime. Prove injectivity using the homogeneous-vector annihilator lemma and restricting to the product chart, where the representative vanishes. Package the bijective additive map as an additive equivalence; its semilinearity and fraction formula are inherited from the canonical map.

theorem gradedModuleSheaf_stalks
    (𝓜 : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (h𝓜 : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓜)
    (hsmul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ℤ) (a : S) (y : M),
      a ∈ 𝒜 n → y ∈ 𝓜 z → a • y ∈ 𝓜 (n + z))
    (Z : ∀ f : Fidx, Submodule R[f] N[f])
    (hZ : (∀ f : Fidx, (Z f : Set N[f]) = degreeZeroFractions
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝒜 n : Set S)) (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝓜 n : Set M))
        (Submonoid.powers f.val.1)))
    (rhoS : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → R[f] →+* R[g])
    (rho : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → Z f →+ Z g)
    (hlaws : (∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]),
        (∃ (e k : ℕ) (a : S), 0 < e ∧ a ∈ 𝒜 k ∧ g.val.1 ^ e = a * f.val.1) ∧
        (∀ (r : R[f]) (q : Z f), rho f g i (r • q) = rhoS f g i r • rho f g i q) ∧
        (∀ (e k : ℕ) (a : S), 0 < e → a ∈ 𝒜 k → g.val.1 ^ e = a * f.val.1 →
          ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : M) (q : Z f),
            (q : N[f]) = mk y (⟨f.val.1 ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f.val.1) →
            (rho f g i q : N[g]) = mk (a ^ m • y)
              (⟨g.val.1 ^ (e * m), ⟨e * m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers g.val.1))) ∧
      (∀ (f : Fidx) (i : D[f] ≤ D[f]) (q : Z f), rho f f i q = q) ∧
      (∀ (f g h : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]) (j : D[h] ≤ D[g]) (q : Z f),
        rho g h j (rho f g i q) = rho f h (j.trans i) q) ∧
      (∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]), D[f] = D[g] →
        Function.Bijective (rho f g i)))
    (F : ModX) (alpha : ∀ f : Fidx, F.val.obj (op D[f]) ≃+ Z f)
    (hchart : (∀ (f : Fidx) (r : R[f]) (s : F.val.obj (op D[f])),
        alpha f ((awayToSection 𝒜 f.val.1 r) • s) = r • alpha f s) ∧
      (∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]) (s : F.val.obj (op D[f])),
        alpha g (F.val.map (homOfLE i).op s) = rho f g i (alpha f s))) :
    ∃ (Zp : ∀ x : Proj 𝒜, Submodule Rp[x] Np[x]),
      (∀ x : Proj 𝒜, (Zp x : Set Np[x]) = degreeZeroFractions
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝒜 n : Set S)) (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝓜 n : Set M)) T[x]) ∧
    ∃ (mu : ∀ x : Proj 𝒜,
      (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (Proj 𝒜).toRingedSpace x).obj F ≃+ Zp x),
      (∀ (x : Proj 𝒜) (r : (Proj 𝒜).presheaf.stalk x)
        (s : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (Proj 𝒜).toRingedSpace x).obj F),
        mu x (r • s) = (stalkIso 𝒜 x).hom r • mu x s) ∧
      (∀ (x : Proj 𝒜) (f : Fidx) (hx : x ∈ D[f]) (m : ℕ) (y : M)
        (q : Z f) (t : T[x]),
        (q : N[f]) = mk y (⟨f.val.1 ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f.val.1) →
        (t : S) = f.val.1 ^ m →
        (mu x (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf D[f] x hx
          ((alpha f).symm q)) : Np[x]) = mk y t)
